plan.notes: Official NMSU 2024-2025 Academic Catalog (archived edition), 'General Business - Bachelor of Business Administration', A Suggested Plan of Study for Students (Las Cruces campus). Roadmap assumes placement in MATH 1220G College Algebra and ENGL 1110G Composition I; not a contract. Catalog publishes per-term totals (16, 16, 15, 15, 15, 15, 15, 13); all terms verified against those totals and the sum = 120, matching 'Total Credits 120'. Upper-division business electives exclude A ST 311; no more than 9 credits in any one prefix among those electives. Final-term 'Elective Course(s)' slot is 4 credits per the catalog roadmap (term total 13); column layout of the PDF is scrambled, so term memberships were reconstructed from the published term totals and are disclosed here. Operations choice: MGMT 344, MGMT 470, or BCIS 485.
